C_optical_sar.query: Compare what the optical and SAR sensors reveal about this area.
C_optical_sar.answer: demo_optical.tif and demo_sar.tif can be analyzed together with 100% spatial overlap. SAR shows structure the optical image does not over 2.9% of the scene (rough/high-backscatter areas that are optically smooth). SAR here is log10-scaled backscatter (uncalibrated; relative intensity only); its structured fraction is 7.9% versus 5.0% for optical brightness, and 25.0% of the scene is SAR-dark (smooth surfaces such as calm water or roads). Notable regions: SAR-revealed structure in the northern part (near 13.5644, 75.0053); optical/SAR water agreement in the southern part (near 13.5571, 75.0073). SAR is illumination-independent, so this structural evidence does not depend on sunlight or cloud cover.
